completion_summary: Implemented two ratchet honesty gates (axiom-census exact-set, sorry-suppression per-file two-count ceiling) that make existing Cslib proof debt visible without discharging any of it. Both land green on the current tree, are wired into CI and pre-pr-check.sh, documented in scripts/README.md, and demonstrably exit 1 on regression / 0 on improvement (Phase 6 evidence: 1,0,1,0,0,0). No .lean file under Cslib/ was modified. One significant, fully-documented deviation: scripts/AxiomCensus.lean implements a shared-cache axiom walker instead of raw per-declaration Lean.collectAxioms calls, because the latter's cross-declaration cache was measured not to fire in this environment (would have cost several minutes, not the ~2.7s the plan's premise assumed); the shared-cache version reproduces the exact settled tainted=43 baseline in ~8.6s.

verification.notes: sorry_count/vacuous_count/axiom_count are 0 for files this task modified (no .lean file under Cslib/ was touched). Repo-wide Cslib/ baseline figures (168 naive-grep sorries, 1 vacuous-regex false-positive at Cslib/Computability/URM/Basic.lean:92, 26 axioms) are pre-existing and unaffected -- confirmed via git status --porcelain Cslib/ and git diff -- Cslib/, both empty throughout. Full 7-step CI pipeline (cache get, lake build, checkInitImports, lake lint, lint-style, shake, mk_all --check, lake test) re-run and green; lake lint and raw lake shake show only pre-existing, unrelated debt in files this task never touched. Both new gates (check-sorry-suppressions.sh, check-axiom-census.sh) exit 0 on the final restored tree.
